# MYSY

Gujarat Govt. Chief Minister Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY) was implemented for bright students of any caste with limited income for higher education under resolution No. Parch/102014/UOR-6/S dated 7/10/2015. Help centers have been started in government colleges so that students can get the benefits of this scheme easily, in this regard, this help center (document verification) has been running in Gujarat Arts and Science College since 2015. Which can be availed by the following students for higher education

* Children of parents whose annual income is less than ₹ 4,50,000 (subject to change from year to year)
* For Diploma Level Courses  Students with 80 or more percentile in 10th exam
* Students with 90 percentile or more in 12th science stream or arts stream examination

Under economic benefits the following benefits are available

Annual Tuition Fee + Equipment- Book Assistance:

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Medical and Dental self-supported courses from Govt. recognized institutes | 50% of the prescribed fee or 2,00,000/- whichever is less    +Rs 10,000/- |
| Self-supported courses from a government recognized institution like Engineering/Technical/Pharmacy/Architecture/Agriculture/  Ayurvedic/Homeopathic/Nursing/Paramedical/Veterinary | 50% of the prescribed fee or 50,000/- whichever is less +Rs 5,000/- |
| Diploma level self- supported courses from a government   recognized institution | 50% of the prescribed fee or 25,000/- whichever is less       +Rs 3,000/- |
| Self-supported courses from government recognized   institutes like BA/ B.Sc./ BBA/ BCA/ B.Com. | 50% of the prescribed fee or 10,000/- whichever is less |

Boarding Allowance: Rs. 1200/- per month Boarding Allowance for 10 months of the year

75% attendance in the educational institution will be mandatory to avail the benefit of this scheme.

**More detailed information of the scheme will be available from MYSY official website** [**https://mysy.guj.nic.in**](https://mysy.guj.nic.in)

# Scholarship Scheme for Students Studying in Government Colleges

Arts

College

Commerce

Higher Education

Scholarship

Science

Student

### Details

The “Scholarship Scheme for Students Studying in Government Colleges” was implemented by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat. It aims to encourage higher education by providing financial support to meritorious students in government colleges. Under this scheme, students of Science, Commerce, and Arts streams receive annual scholarships to pursue higher education.

### Benefits

> Scholarships are provided to students:

*   Science stream: ₹3,000 per annum.
*   Commerce stream: ₹2,000 per annum.
*   Arts stream: ₹1,000 per annum.

### Eligibility

1.   The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat state. 
2.   The applicant must be a student.
3.   The applicant must be studying in a government college in Gujarat.
4.   The applicant must be pursuing higher education in Arts, Commerce, or Science stream.
5.   The applicant must have passed the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) examination.
6.   The applicant should have secured a rank in the first, second, or third position at the university level in Arts, Commerce, or Science.

### Application Process

Online

> **Application Process:**

**Step 1:** The applicant may visit the Digital Gujarat Portal: [https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/)

**Step 2:** On the home page, click on ‘Register’ and the applicant will be redirected to the registration form page.

**Step 3:** Enter your Mobile Number, Email, Set Password, and then click on ‘Save’.

**Step 4:** After successful registration, the applicant can login through his/her User Name (Mobile No./Email ID) and Password.

**Step 5:** Now, click on ‘My Profile’ to update your profile and fill in all the mandatory information.

**Step 6:** After filling in profile details, click on ‘Update Profile’. The profile will be updated after entering the verification Code (OTP).

**Step 7:** Now under services, select ‘Scholarship Services’ and then click on ‘SC Scheme’.

**Step 8:**Select the Financial Year for which you want to apply for and then click on ‘Change Financial Year’.

**Step 9:** Select the scheme, read the interaction carefully, and then click on ‘Continue to Service’.

**Step 10:** Fill in the application form completely and upload all the relevant documents.

**Step 11:** Now, click on ‘Save as Draft’ and agree with the terms & conditions, and submit the application form by clicking on ‘Confirm & Final Submit’. 

> **Instructions:**

**Note 1:** Photo uploading for all applicants is mandatory.

**Note 2:** Application will be considered complete only when all sections are completed.

**Note 3:** Only one application per applicant will be acceptable for a scholarship. If any student submits more than one application either from a single institute or from multiple institutions his/her all applications will be rejected by the competent authority and no request from any side will be entertained.

**Note 4:** In case of any wrong/misleading information provided in the application shall lead to rejection of the application by Department Authorities.

**Note 5:**All required documents must be carefully scanned as per the instructions given.

**Note 6:** The student has to fill his/her application carefully as there is no provision for institution change once the application is submitted successfully.

**Note 7:** The unreadable uploaded documents will allow the competent authority to reject the student application.

**Note 8:** Direct Individual submission of this application form will not be accepted in case of students studying inside the state. Only outside students have to fill out their form online and submit his/her application form to their native district officer.

[User Manual](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/loginapp/Download/User_Manual_on_CSP_v1.1.pdf)- English

[User Manual](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/loginapp/Download/GUser_Manual_on_CSP_v1.1.pdf)- Gujarati

### Documents Required

*   Graduate Marksheet
*   HSC Pass Certificate
*   Any Other Document if Required

### Frequently Asked Questions

Who is eligible for this scholarship?

Students studying in Arts, Commerce, or Science streams in government colleges in Gujarat.

How much scholarship is given?

₹3,000 for Science students, ₹2,000 for Commerce students, and ₹1,000 for Arts students.

Is this scheme applicable for private college students?

No, it is only for government college students.

Do I need to pay for the application form?

No, the application is free of cost.

Can students of all categories apply?

Yes, it is open to all categories.

Is there any income limit?

No, there is no income limit under this scheme.

What is the main objective of this scheme?

To support meritorious students and promote higher education.

Is there any requirement for minimum marks?

Yes, the student must secure top positions (first, second, or third) at the university level.

Is this scheme applicable across Gujarat?

Yes, it is applicable across all government colleges in the state.

Is this scheme available for students from all states?

No, this scheme is only for permanent residents of Gujarat.

**Step 3:** Enter all details and click on "Login".

> **How to Apply for a New Service:**

**Step 1:** After logging in, select the relevant department.

### Frequently Asked Questions

What is the objective of the "Fellowship Scholarship Scheme"?

The "Fellowship Scholarship Scheme" is a financial aid program launched by the Education Department, Government of Gujarat, to provide annual monetary assistance to students who secure 70% or more in Class 10 and continue their higher education.

Who is eligible to apply for the scheme?

A student who has scored at least 70% marks in Class 10th, belongs to SC, ST, Physically Backward Class, or other eligible categories, and is pursuing higher secondary, college, or higher education can apply for the scheme.

Is there any income limit for applying?

Yes, the applicant’s personal annual income and family annual income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- to be eligible for the scheme.

What type of financial assistance is provided under the scheme?

The scheme provides scholarships to eligible students based on their merit in Class 11th and subsequent studies.

How often is the scholarship amount disbursed?

The scholarship amount is disbursed annually after verification of the student’s application and academic performance.

Are students from all categories eligible?

Yes, students from SC, ST, Physically Backward Classes, and other eligible categories can apply for this scheme.

Is there any minimum marks requirement?

Yes, the student must have secured at least 70% marks in Class 10 to qualify for the scholarship.

How can a student apply for this scheme?

Students can apply through the [Digital Gujarat](https://www.digitalgujarat.gov.in/) portal.

Which documents are mandatory for applying?

Documents such as Aadhar Card, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Class 10 Mark Sheet, School Leaving Certificate, and a Passport Size Photograph etc are mandatory for applying.

What is the geographical coverage of this scheme?

The scheme is applicable across the state of Gujarat and covers all eligible students within the state.
